summary: A 19-year-old man was struck by lightning while camping in Ruby Gulch; he and his girlfriend had been standing next to their tent when the bolt hit him. The woman performed CPR, helped him to their vehicle, and drove to the Peak-to-Peak Highway/Forest Service Road 328 intersection, where Nederland Fire and Indian Peaks Fire treated him until AMR arrived.
responding_agency: Nederland Fire Protection District; Indian Peaks Fire Protection District; American Medical Response
notes: Transported to Boulder Community Hospital, conscious and breathing. 'On Saturday' + print-edition date 2018-07-12 and the companion item's 'Sunday, July 8' -> 2018-07-07.
